About Us

PDR Dent Removal In Melksham

We are a local paintless dent removal business working out of Melksham and covering the towns and villages around it. Dent work is all we do, so a car does not sit in a queue behind parts and paint jobs. Send a photo, get a straight answer, book it in.

No paint. No filler. No respray. Your car keeps its original factory finish, and its history stays clean.

Why Choose Everdent PDR

  • The original paint stays onNo colour matching, no lacquer, no blending into the next panel. The finish is the one the factory put there.
  • Quick turnaroundMost single dents are measured in hours rather than days, so you are not left without the car for a week.
  • Better for the environmentNo fillers, no solvents, no paint waste and no sanding dust. Nothing goes into the repair that has to be disposed of afterwards.
  • Insurance approved techniquesThe same methods bodyshops and insurers recognise, usually at a fraction of a full panel repair.
What We Do

Our Services

Every job below is done without paint, filler or a respray. If a dent cannot be put right that way, we will say so before we start.

Not sure which one you have? Send a photo and we will tell you straight, no obligation.

Door Ding Repair

Small round dents from car doors, trolleys and knocks, pushed out without touching the paint.

Bodyline Dent Repair

Dents on the swage line reshaped accurately so the crease runs straight again.

Door Edge Repair

Folded door edges from walls, posts and other cars, carefully worked back to shape.

Hail Damage Repair

Dozens of small hail dents removed panel by panel, with no paint and no filler.

Crease Dent Repair

Long, folded creases eased out gradually until the panel reads flat again.

Severe & Complex Dents

Deep, sharp or clustered damage that needs the metal massaging back in stages.
The Process

How It Works

Four steps from the photo on your phone to the dent being gone. No garage visit just to find out what it costs.

Step One

Send Us A Photo

Take a clear picture or a short video of the damage. Get the whole panel in frame and catch the light across the dent, because that is what shows us the depth.

Step Two

We Come Back With A Price

We look at what you have sent, tell you straight whether PDR will put it right, and give you a price. No trip to a garage just to get quoted.

Step Three

Book A Time That Suits You

Happy with the price? We put you in the diary at a time that works around your week rather than ours.

Step Four

We Come To You

We turn up at the agreed time, carry out the repair, and hand the car back with the paint it left the factory with.

Guaranteed Satisfaction

We do not call a repair finished until you have looked over the panel yourself and you are happy with it.

Common Questions

FAQ

It is a way of removing dents by working the metal back to its original shape from behind the panel, using specialist rods and reflection boards. Because the panel is never filled, sanded or resprayed, your car keeps the paint it left the factory with.

No. That is the whole point of PDR. There is no filler, no primer, no colour matching and no lacquer. If a repair genuinely needs paint, we will tell you straight away rather than starting work and finding out halfway through.

Door dings, dents along a bodyline, folded door edges, hail damage, creases and a lot of the deeper or more complex damage people assume is a bodyshop job. Send us a photo and we will give you an honest answer.

Yes. If the paint is cracked, chipped or split, or the metal has been stretched or torn, PDR will not put it right on its own. Very sharp damage right on the edge of a panel can also be beyond it. We would rather turn work away than hand back a repair we are not happy with.

Most single dents are measured in hours rather than days. Larger jobs like hail damage across several panels take longer because every dent is worked individually. We will give you a realistic time before we start.

We are based in Melksham and cover Bowerhill, Chippenham, Corsham, Trowbridge, Calne, Devizes and Bradford on Avon, along with the wider Wiltshire and Bristol area.

Often, yes. Paintless dent removal uses techniques that insurers and bodyshops recognise, and it is usually the cheaper route for a claim because there is no paint, no parts and no lengthy bodyshop booking. Check with your insurer first and we will work with whatever they need.

It works in your favour. Original factory paint is one of the first things a buyer or a dealer checks, and a panel that has never been resprayed keeps its history clean.
